notes: The source URL and text are the Associate in Science in Sports, Fitness, and Recreation Management page; the text prints no section for the Certificate of Achievement, so no blocks were recorded for the certificate.

The closed list is a subset of the A.S. major (it omits ANAT R101, PHSO R101, STAT C1000, KIN R122, KIN R140 and others), which suggests the certificate's requirements differ from the A.S.; a reviewer should locate the certificate's own catalog page.

The A.S. section prints Required Core Courses (12 units: KIN R110, KIN R100, BUS R120, BUS R121), List A: Complete Two Courses (6-10 units), List B: Complete Two Courses (2-6 units), Total Required Major Units 20-28, Oxnard College General Education 24 or Cal-GETC 34, and Total Units Required for AS Degree 60; these belong to the A.S., not the certificate.
The page's outcomes tab prints three program student learning outcomes on the A.S. page; it is not stated that the certificate shares them, so program.outcomes is left empty.
The closed list spells KIN R124A as 'Jujutsu I'; the catalog prints 'Jujitsu I'.
